description: Rockslide Elemental's four +1/+1 counters cannot be placed at setup, so two Tephraderm-vs-Tephraderm combats kill four creatures first (each mirror trades via the damage-reflection triggers), with B saying Yes to Rockslide's optional death trigger four times. In each mirror combat B's second Tephraderm dies during resolution of A's reflection trigger, so B briefly has two simultaneous triggers (its own Tephraderm reflection trigger plus Rockslide's death trigger) and an order choice ('Rockslide Elemental' goes on the stack first; the dead Tephraderm's reflection then fizzles against the already-dead attacker). On turn 5 A attacks with the last Tephraderm and the 5/5 first-strike Rockslide blocks: Rockslide kills Tephraderm in the first-strike step; the death trigger (stacked after the active player's reflection trigger) resolves first making Rockslide 6/6, then Tephraderm's trigger deals 5 damage and Rockslide survives.
